🚨 LEBRON RUINS THE 76ERS?! BENCHES MAXEY FOR BRONNY! 💀🏀😱 (LEGM GOES TOO FAR!) Did LeBron James just commit the most shocking franchise sabotage in NBA history?! 🚨💀 In this ultra-unhinged 3D animated LeGM saga, King James takes over the Philadelphia 76ers and immediately orchestrates a wild multi-team trade—shipping All-Star Jaylen Brown to the Los Angeles Lakers alongside Luka Dončić and Rob Pelinka just to bring Bronny James to Philly! But the madness doesn't stop there. Once Bronny arrives, LeBron drops the ultimate bombshell: benching All-NBA superstar Tyrese Maxey so Bronny can start at point guard as the franchise player... while LeBron snatches Luka's recovery chocolate chip cookies for himself! 🍪🔥 Watch as Jaylen Brown rages over being traded five minutes after signing, Rob Pelinka panics, Luka Dončić defends his beer stash, and Tyrese Maxey completely crashes out after losing his starting spot to nepotism! Is this the ultimate LeGM masterclass or did LeBron just destroy the Philadelphia 76ers from the inside out?
